images.alt: Мастер расписывает традиционную фигурку из теста в Кальдероне — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Wide 16:9 premium photorealistic editorial illustration for travel website showing traditional mazapan handicraft workshop in Calderon north of Quito Ecuador. Close inviting still life of small hand-painted decorative flour-dough figurines: Andean women in bright woven skirts and hats, tiny flowers, birds, miniature animals on a worn wooden work table at right, brushes and colored pigments, artisan hands carefully painting one miniature visible. Mazapan here means durable decorative bread-dough crafts, NOT almond sweets or edible cakes. Simple modest workshop soft window daylight, shallow depth of field, natural handmade slight imperfections, quiet left foreground for title. No flags invented logos or text, no money watermark collage.
